findings.fix: State the condition and the remedy: "7-day refund if the audit finds nothing", not a blanket guarantee.
Remove the money promise. Show the mechanism and the range actually observed.

findings.message: Currency is not INR on an India-targeted page.
findings.fix: Show INR. If you also accept USD, show both with the exchange basis.
Make the displayed price GST-inclusive and show the breakup.
State the window (for example 7 or 30 days), the condition and how to claim.
Add a monitored email and, for India, a WhatsApp link.
Add one primary button with the price and what happens next.
Use a real, dated deadline that applies to every buyer, or remove it.

findings.message: Price excludes GST and adds it later (drip pricing).
findings.fix: Display the final GST-inclusive price on the page. Show the GST breakup, not a surprise at checkout.

findings.message: GSTIN does not match the 15-character format.
findings.fix: Recheck the GSTIN on the GST portal before publishing.
Say "instant download" or the exact turnaround.

findings.message: UPI is not listed as a payment method.
findings.fix: Enable UPI and show it at checkout; it is the dominant consumer payment rail in India.
Use a real, attributable quote with permission, or remove it.

findings.message: Terms or privacy page is missing.
findings.fix: Link both in the footer; digital sales need terms, refund and privacy pages.
Add the before/after or the number the buyer reported.
